CORPORATE GOVERNANCE

BYLAWS
OF
MERIDIAN HOLDINGS, INC.
(A Delaware Corporation)

Adopted as of: February 1, 2023

ARTICLE I — OFFICES

The registered office of the Corporation in the State of Delaware shall be located at 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, DE 19801. The Corporation may also have offices at such other places as the Board of Directors may from time to time determine.

ARTICLE II — STOCKHOLDERS' MEETINGS

Section 1. Annual Meeting. The annual meeting of stockholders shall be held on the second Tuesday of May of each year at 10:00 a.m., at the principal office of the Corporation.

Section 2. Special Meetings. Special meetings of stockholders may be called by the Chairman of the Board, the Chief Executive Officer, or by a majority of the Board of Directors.

ARTICLE III — BOARD OF DIRECTORS

Section 1. Number. The Board shall consist of not less than three (3) nor more than nine (9) directors, with the exact number set by resolution.

Section 2. Term. Directors shall serve for a term of one year and until their successors are elected and qualified.

ARTICLE IV — OFFICERS

The officers of the Corporation shall include a President, a Secretary, and a Treasurer. The President may also serve as Chief Executive Officer.

APPROVED AND ADOPTED:

/s/ Thomas Meridian
Thomas Meridian, Incorporator

/s/ Elizabeth Warren
Elizabeth Warren, Incorporator

State of Delaware
Division of Corporations
Filed: February 1, 2023
